differences.what: the palm house: a round drum standing out of the wing's south face, about 7.6 m across its entablature (x 350-500 px), its centre 12.1 m east of the house wall
differences.how: T-3165: the K13 bay rebuilt as a 3.35 m glass drum of six facets under a 0.45 m entablature and moved 3.0 m east along the wing; the render's entablature spans x 350-500 and its centre falls at x 425

differences.what: a column at every facet joint, standing on a stone base, carrying an entablature; glazing between the columns
differences.how: T-3165: a stone column at each of the seven joints from the drum's base at 2.75 m to the eave at 6.25 m, glass between them; column bases at about y 605 and capitals at y 540 in both

differences.what: a balustrade round the drum's flat top, level with the wing's own parapet balustrade
differences.how: T-3165: a 0.9 m balustrade on the entablature and a 0.9 m parapet along the wing, both topping out at about 8.05 m (y 500 in both)

differences.what: a ribbed dome rising out of the drum's top behind its balustrade, with a finial, about 4 m across and topping out near y 457
differences.how: T-3165: a 1.9 m ribbed dome on a short collar, springing at 7.9 m, rib every other meridian, 0.5 m finial; its top at y 458

differences.what: the wing a one-storey stone range with a parapet, from the house's east wall to the belvedere
differences.how: T-3165: the stand-in block runs 12.1 m west and 9.7 m east of the drum, 7.1 m to its top, in a light stone tone; its ends at x 180 and x 612 as in the print

differences.what: an arched doorway in the wing east of the drum and an arched window west of it
differences.how: T-3165: two dark arched openings, the door centred 6.8 m east (head 5.2 m), the window 7.3 m west (head 5.4 m), within about 10 px of the print's

differences.what: the terrace before the range with a broad flight of steps rising to the drum and balustrades either side
differences.how: T-3165: a 1.4 m terrace 6 m deep with an eight-riser flight 6 m wide on the drum's axis and a 0.9 m balustrade either side; the flight's top at about the print's landing, the balustrades' tops within about 0.35 m; it stops at the house's east wall, behind the porch in this view

differences.what: the balustrades are open balusters between dies and piers, the columns round with bases and capitals, the wall rusticated with a pilaster either side of the drum, and urns on the terrace piers (T-1934; were drawn solid, octagonal and plain)
differences.how: T-3153: drawn as solid parapets, octagonal shafts and a plain wall; heights, places and outlines agree within about 0.3 m, so the difference is in relief and openwork under the bar

differences.what: the wing's face reads darker than the stable's in the print, the build draws both in a light stone; whether that is the stone or the trees' shade over it is not settled
differences.how: in the trees' shade (the print's own shadows); the 1894 Inland plate shows the range and the stable in the same light stone, which the render follows. Colour itself is not shown (a monochrome print)

differences.what: the dome's covering: glass or metal sheets between the ribs
differences.how: the print shows a ribbed dome of light panels; whether glass or metal is not legible at this size. Built in the kit's opaque glass substitute (see the record's note)

differences.what: the north half of the rotunda behind the wing's face, the wing's roof and its north side
differences.how: the camera stands south of the range

differences.what: the stable's arcade on its west face, receding toward the drum, its arches between the corner bay and the range (x 640-700 px)
differences.how: T-3193: what T-3192 read as a 3.2 m arcade on the 18th Street front is the west face foreshortened; the camera re-solved nearer (see its solve) shows the face at the print's angle, and the arcade moved onto it

differences.what: the polygonal bay at the stable's south-west corner (x 690-800 px), its cornice at about 4.5 m, round-headed lights
differences.how: T-3193: the bay across the corner; within about 20 px

differences.what: the stable's front east of the bay: three bays of sash in two storeys
differences.how: T-3193: the sash at 4.7, 8.3 and 11.2 m east of the corner; the render's at x 860, 955 and 1023 against the print's 864, 951 and 1020

differences.what: the stable's hipped roof springing from the first-floor cornice to a crested deck, the upper storey carried up through it
differences.how: T-3192's forms, carried round the cut corner by T-3193

differences.what: the square belvedere over the range's parapet at the wing's east end
differences.how: T-3192; moved 1.2 m west by T-3193 from the plate

differences.what: the stable's roof meets its walls below the upper storey as a projecting band about 0.4 m deep where the print shows a moulded belt course (the owner named it, 2026-10-28)
differences.how: T-1934: a moulded stone belt course about 0.36 m deep, its top where the lower slope meets the wall, the upper sash on it; the stable is now judged in its own records (data/reference_views/pullman_house_1729_prairie_ranges/)

differences.what: the stable's lantern, the stack at the front's east end and the deck's east end
differences.how: the tree crowns cover the roof's east half; the plate and 16554 show them

differences.what: T-3161 re-laid the house's 18th Street flank from Taylor's photograph no. 1445: the house at this print's left edge is its east end, which changed only in its second-storey lights (a pair at s 22.8-23.9 for the single ones), behind the awning and the trees here

in the foreground, the lot's 18th Street line east of the side wall's end (u 35 in the house's frame): square stone piers with a coping either side of the court's walk, and a run of posts on a lower curb; none of it is built (the owner, 2026-10-28: the lot's wall and its planting are judged in the match)
differences.how: the 18th Street wall built (T-1934): on the lot line from the house's east end to the stable's east wall, through the plate's camera rays from five pier bases put it, the 0.9 m wall with its chamfered coping, square piers 1.7-1.8 m high, the opening onto the terrace's west flight, the low wall falling steeply from the third pier and curving up again to the fourth, the opening onto the east flight, and the wall on low along the stable's front (pullman_house_1729_prairie form.boundary); its lamps, the planting and the trees are judged in their own lines below

differences.what: the glazing between the columns reads dark, the palm house's shaded inside behind it, where the build showed the wing's pale stone through the glass (T-1934)
the dome broad and light, about 4.6 m across, close-ribbed (x 512-680 px); the build's was 3.8 m and dark (T-1934)
the terrace's approach: two flights rising from the walk between low curved cheek walls and square piers (x 210-830 px), where the build has one flight from grade to the terrace

the planting: the four parkway and yard trees across the front, the clipped shrubs and potted palms on and before the terrace, none of them built (the owner, 2026-10-28: the lot's wall and its planting are judged in the match)

through this camera the new 18th Street wall renders about twice as near and as wide as the print shows it: the camera's eye stands 9.9 m from the lot line (v -37.9), but the print's road and its far parkway put the wall about 20 m off, and the gate piers at the print's right and left edge stand on 18th Street's SOUTH side, not on this lot's line as the T-3193 solve took them. The plate's camera, fitted on this wall's own pier bases, puts the build within 30 px; so this camera wants re-solving with the wall's piers in its fit before the wall can be judged from it
differences.how: T-1934 render; the camera, not the build, is what differs
